name: Earth-Agent
title: Earth-Agent: Unlocking the Full Landscape of Earth Observation with Agents
topic: Multimodal Earth observation tools and evaluation
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/ICLR/Earth-Agent - Unlocking the Full Landscape of Earth Observation with Agents.pdf
summary: Earth-Agent exposes 104 professional tools through MCP and connects reasoning to RGB imagery, spectral observations, and Earth products. EarthBench evaluates both autonomous planning and execution from explicit instructions, with step-level and final-outcome measures.

name: GeoEvolver
title: Experience-Driven Multi-Agent Systems Are Training-free Context-aware Earth Observers
topic: Experience-driven exploration and memory
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/Experience-Driven Multi-Agent Systems Are Training-free Context-aware Earth Observers.pdf
summary: A retrieval-augmented orchestrator decomposes tasks, explores alternative tool parameters through multiple agents, and contrasts successful and failed attempts. Root-cause analysis distills experience into contextual tool constraints for subsequent retrieval, without updating language-model weights.

name: GeoForge
title: GeoForge: Non-Parametric Self-Evolving Agents for Earth-Observation Reasoning
topic: Non-parametric evolution for Earth observation
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/GeoForge - Non-Parametric Self-Evolving Agents for Earth-Observation Reasoning.pdf
summary: Combines workflow graphs, action experiences, and skill SOPs with sensing-aware tool filtering and gated memory updates.

name: GeoMMAgent
title: GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent: Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing
topic: Expert multimodal geoscience reasoning
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/CVPR/GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent - Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing.pdf
summary: GeoMMBench evaluates this broader expertise. GeoMMAgent combines retrieval, perception, and reasoning specialists with external remote sensing models, using a zero-shot agent framework rather than fine-tuning a new foundation model.

name: HiRS-Agent
title: HiRS-Agent: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving
topic: Hierarchical remote sensing agents and reliable execution
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/ACM-MM/HiRS-Agent - A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving.pdf
summary: Organizes long-horizon remote sensing workflows into manager and specialist roles, combining step-level verification, expert tuning, and hierarchical reinforcement learning.

name: OpenEarth-Agent
title: OpenEarth-Agent: From Tool Calling to Tool Creation for Open-Environment Earth Observation
topic: Tool creation for open-environment Earth observation
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/OpenEarth-Agent - From Tool Calling to Tool Creation for Open-Environment Earth Observation.pdf
summary: Creates tools and adapts workflows to unfamiliar data, evaluating complete Earth-observation pipelines in OpenEarth-Bench.

name: OpenEarthAgent
title: OpenEarthAgent: A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents
topic: Training compact geospatial tool-using agents
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/OpenEarthAgent - A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents.pdf
summary: The framework standardizes tool schemas and builds validated trajectories across optical, SAR, and GIS tasks. It trains Qwen3-4B on 14,538 examples using supervised, response-only learning, with tool outputs retained as context. Evaluation contains 1,169 examples. This is distinct from OpenEarth-Agent, the separately indexed tool-creation paper.

name: RemoteAgent
title: RemoteAgent: Bridging Vague Human Intents and Earth Observation with RL-based Agentic MLLMs
topic: Resolving vague intents with reinforcement learning
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/RemoteAgent - Bridging Vague Human Intents and Earth Observation with RL-based Agentic MLLMs.pdf
summary: VagueEO supplies ambiguous requests, and reinforcement learning with GRPO and LoRA adapts Qwen2.5-VL-7B to infer intent and choose execution strategies. Sparse visual tasks can be handled internally, while dense predictions use specialized tools through MCP.

name: RS-Agent
title: RS-Agent: Automating Remote Sensing Tasks through Intelligent Agent
topic: Domain knowledge and remote sensing tool orchestration
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/SCIS/RS-Agent - Automating Remote Sensing Tasks through Intelligent Agent.pdf
summary: A central controller coordinates a dynamic toolkit, a solution space of expert workflows, and a knowledge space. Task-Aware Retrieval first identifies the task and then retrieves suitable solutions. DualRAG combines complementary retrieval paths to supply domain evidence. The controller uses these resources to plan and execute optical and SAR workflows.

name: RS-Claw
title: RS-Claw: Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents
topic: Hierarchical skills and active tool exploration
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/arXiv/RS-Claw - Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents.pdf
summary: Uses semantically organized skill trees and progressive disclosure to balance tool availability with context cost.

name: RSMeM
title: RSMeM: Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents with Systematic Evaluation
topic: Knowledge-guided memory evolution
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2026/ACL/RSMeM - Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents with Systematic Evaluation.pdf
summary: RSMeM combines a hierarchical knowledge base and task cards with failure-aware experience refinement. GeoTraceCompress distills trajectories into compact memories, while reflection records constraints that can guide later tool use.

name: GeoEvolve
title: GeoEvolve: Automating Geospatial Model Discovery via Multi-Agent Large Language Models
topic: Automated geospatial algorithm discovery
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2025/arXiv/GeoEvolve - Automating Geospatial Model Discovery via Multi-Agent Large Language Models.pdf
summary: Combines evolutionary code search with retrieved geospatial knowledge to improve classical spatial models.

name: Multi-Agent-Geospatial-Copilots
title: Multi-Agent Geospatial Copilots for Remote Sensing Workflows
topic: Specialist collaboration and workflow memory
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2025/IGARSS/Multi-Agent Geospatial Copilots for Remote Sensing Workflows.pdf
summary: GeoLLM-Squad builds on GeoLLM-Engine and AutoGen, assigning specialist agents and using an orchestrator to coordinate dependencies. Intent-based tool selection and workflow memory help reuse successful execution patterns.

name: RingMo-Agent
title: RingMo-Agent: A Unified Remote Sensing Foundation Model for Multi-Platform and Multi-Modal Reasoning
topic: Multi-platform, multi-modal remote sensing foundation models
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2025/arXiv/RingMo-Agent - A Unified Remote Sensing Foundation Model for Multi-Platform and Multi-Modal Reasoning.pdf
summary: Combines RS-VL3M training data, modality-specific representations, and task-aware decoding for remote sensing perception and reasoning.

name: ThinkGeo
title: ThinkGeo: Evaluating Tool-Augmented Agents for Remote Sensing Tasks
topic: Step-level evaluation of remote sensing tool use
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2025/arXiv/ThinkGeo - Evaluating Tool-Augmented Agents for Remote Sensing Tasks.pdf
summary: ThinkGeo provides 486 tasks with 1,778 expert-verified reasoning steps across seven application domains. It evaluates a ReAct-style agent using perception, operation, and logic tools, separating instruction, tool, argument, summary, and final-answer quality.

name: Change-Agent
title: Change-Agent: Towards Interactive Comprehensive Remote Sensing Change Interpretation and Analysis
venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
topic: Interactive change detection and description
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2024/IEEE-TGRS/Change-Agent - Towards Interactive Comprehensive Remote Sensing Change Interpretation and Analysis.pdf
summary: A multi-level change interpretation model jointly predicts pixel-level changes and semantic descriptions. Bidirectional iterative interaction connects these outputs. An LLM agent then plans and invokes Python tools to answer requests such as locating, describing, and counting changes.

name: GeoLLM-Engine
title: GeoLLM-Engine: A Realistic Environment for Building Geospatial Copilots
topic: Executable environments for geospatial copilots
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2024/CVPR-Workshops/GeoLLM-Engine - A Realistic Environment for Building Geospatial Copilots.pdf
summary: GeoLLM-Engine supplies more than 175 tools spanning imagery, databases, mapping interfaces, and external knowledge. A formal environment state and model checking support executable workflows and automatically constructed evaluation queries.

name: Remote-Sensing-ChatGPT
title: Remote Sensing ChatGPT: Solving Remote Sensing Tasks with ChatGPT and Visual Models
topic: Language-driven orchestration of visual models
pdf: papers/remote-sensing/2024/IGARSS/Remote Sensing ChatGPT - Solving Remote Sensing Tasks with ChatGPT and Visual Models.pdf
summary: ChatGPT interprets the request, plans subtasks, calls visual models, and explains their outputs. Visual cues convert image information into text that the language model can use. The toolkit combines scene classification, land-use segmentation, detection, captioning, edge extraction, polygon simplification, and counting.

name: EvoSkill
title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
topic: Validated iterative skill discovery
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/EvoSkill - Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems.pdf
summary: An executor produces task evidence, a proposer identifies promising improvements, and a skill builder implements candidate skills. Validation selects useful candidates and maintains an improvement frontier for subsequent evolution.

name: MemSkill
title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
topic: Learning and evolving memory operations
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/MemSkill - Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents.pdf
summary: A controller selects memory skills, an executor applies them, and a designer refines or adds skills using difficult cases. The controller is optimized with reinforcement learning, while the skill inventory can evolve through language-based design.

name: MMSkills
title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
topic: Multimodal skill representation and runtime consultation
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/MMSkills - Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents.pdf
summary: Binds reusable procedures to visual state cards and keyframes, consulting them in a temporary branch to guide live interaction.

name: SkillCAT
title: SkillCAT: Contrastive, Assessment-Augmented and Topology-Aware Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
topic: Contrastive extraction, patch assessment, and skill routing
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/SkillCAT - Contrastive, Assessment-Augmented and Topology-Aware Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents.pdf
summary: Contrastive Causal Extraction compares same-task successes and failures. Assessment-Augmented Evolution replays candidate patches on source-task clones and filters harmful changes before hierarchical merging. Topology-Aware Task Execution loads relevant sub-skill nodes instead of the entire collection.

name: SkillOpt
title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
topic: Controlled optimization of textual agent skills
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/SkillOpt - Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills.pdf
summary: SkillOpt treats a compact textual skill as the optimization state while keeping the model frozen. Bounded rollout-and-reflection edits, a textual learning rate, slower meta-updates, a held-out acceptance gate, and rejected-edit memory control the optimization process.

name: SkillsBench
title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
topic: Benchmarking the effectiveness of agent skills
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/SkillsBench - Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks.pdf
summary: Pairs expertise-heavy tasks with skills and deterministic verifiers to measure when procedural guidance helps or hurts.

name: Trace2Skill
title: Trace2Skill: Distill Trajectory-Local Lessons into Transferable Agent Skills
topic: Distilling portable skills from execution traces
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/arXiv/Trace2Skill - Distill Trajectory-Local Lessons into Transferable Agent Skills.pdf
summary: Parallel analysts inspect trajectories and propose evidence-grounded skill patches. Hierarchical consolidation resolves overlaps and conflicts into a portable skill directory. The framework can deepen an existing skill or build a new one from experience.

name: XSkill
title: XSkill: Continual Learning from Experience and Skills in Multimodal Agents
topic: Continual learning from experiences and skills
pdf: papers/general-skills/2026/ICML/XSkill - Continual Learning from Experience and Skills in Multimodal Agents.pdf
summary: Distills task-level skills and action-level experiences from visual trajectories, then retrieves and adapts both without updating model parameters.

name: AWM
title: Agent Workflow Memory
topic: Reusable workflow memory for web agents
pdf: papers/general-skills/2025/ICML/Agent Workflow Memory.pdf
summary: Agent Workflow Memory induces reusable workflows from examples and adds them to the agent context. It supports offline induction from training examples and online induction from successful episodes, allowing later tasks to reuse accumulated procedures.

name: SkillWeaver
title: SkillWeaver: Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills
topic: Discovering and refining callable web skills
pdf: papers/general-skills/2025/arXiv/SkillWeaver - Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills.pdf
summary: An exploration process proposes useful website skills, implements them as Playwright Python APIs, and practices and repairs them using execution feedback. Successful APIs form a composable library that a downstream agent can invoke.

name: ExpeL
title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
topic: Natural-language lessons and experience retrieval
pdf: papers/general-skills/2024/AAAI/ExpeL - LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners.pdf
summary: ExpeL gathers trajectories, extracts natural-language insights from successful and failed experiences, and retrieves relevant successful demonstrations at inference time. Learning occurs in external experience and insight memory rather than through model-weight updates.

name: Voyager
title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
topic: Executable skill libraries and automatic curricula
pdf: papers/general-skills/2024/TMLR/Voyager - An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models.pdf
summary: An automatic curriculum proposes progressively useful Minecraft tasks. GPT-4 generates executable code, repairs it using environment feedback and self-verification, and stores successful programs in a retrievable skill library. Model weights remain fixed.
